default_mode.description: Default posture for unknown/unspecified adapter ids. Prefer 'disabled' (deny-by-default).

adapters.description: Explicit per-adapter kill posture. Each adapter lane remains an optional/killable choice; this policy is the single control surface.

adapter_id.description: Canonical adapter id (e.g., ports-pkg, full-tuf, oci-transport, linux-abi-compat).

mode.description: Adapter lane phase. 'disabled' is the kill switch. 'shadow' runs side-by-side; 'replace' means the adapter path is on the critical path (treat as high leverage).

scopes.description: Where the adapter is permitted to operate. Broadening to 'runtime' is high leverage.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry for temporary compatibility modes. Expired adapters should be treated as disabled by policy.

required_receipts.description: Optional list of receipt kinds that must be present when this adapter executes (e.g., content.import.receipt, closure.proof).

reason.description: Short justification for enabling or shadowing this adapter.
